name: ElevenLabs
positioning: A voice-AI platform whose text-to-speech API offers expressive, multi-language models, a large voice library and voice cloning, alongside speech-to-text, agents and audio tools.

pricing.model: Per-character API list prices quoted per 1K characters on the ElevenAPI pricing page, also available through monthly subscription plans that include a shared credit pool (1 credit per character on most models; Flash/Turbo models cost 0.5 to 1 credit per character).
pricing.headline: $0.04 per 1K characters ($40 per 1M) for Flash / Turbo; flagship v4 and v3 models list at $0.08 per 1K ($80 per 1M).
pricing.headlineTier: Flash / Turbo (Flash v2.5), API list price, excluding promotions

tiers.name: Eleven v4
tiers.notes: Promotional price $22 per 1M characters shown as '72% off until Oct 12'. Up to 10,000 characters per request; 90+ languages.

tiers.name: Eleven v4 Turbo
tiers.notes: Promotional price $11 per 1M characters shown as '72% off until Oct 12'. Vendor-stated median inference latency ~100ms.

tiers.name: Eleven v3 Conversational
tiers.notes: Low-latency v3 tuned for realtime conversation; vendor-stated ~280ms.

tiers.name: Flash / Turbo (Flash v2.5)
tiers.notes: 40,000 character limit per request; 32 languages; the models page describes it as 50% lower price per character for API generations.

tiers.name: Subscription plans (credits)
tiers.notes: Free $0 (10,000 credits), Starter $6 (30,000), Creator $22 (121,000), Pro $99 (600,000), Scale $299 (1,800,000), Business $990 (6,000,000), Enterprise custom. Credits are shared across all products.

pricing.freeTier: Free plan: $0 per month with 10,000 credits per month (about 10 minutes of audio per the pricing page). The Commercial License is listed as starting at the Starter plan.
promotions: Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo shown at 72% off until Oct 12 (v4 $0.022 and v4 Turbo $0.011 per 1K characters instead of $0.08 and $0.04). Source says 'Oct 12'; year not printed, retrieved 2026-10-10 so read as 2026-10-12.
Site banner: 3x credits included on Creator and above until October 12.
Starter plan first month $1 (83% off $6), shown 'Until Oct 18'; Creator first month $11 (50% off $22).

voices.count: 3,000+ community-shared voices in the Voice Library per docs; the Voice Changer entry on the pricing page cites 17,000+ voices
voices.languages: 29 (Multilingual v2), 32 (Flash v2.5), 70+ (v3), 90+ (v4 and v4 Turbo), depending on model
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Instant Voice Cloning (short samples, available on most plans, Starter and up per pricing page) and Professional Voice Cloning (Creator plan or above; verification step confirms the voice is the account holder's own; docs say cloning someone else's voice is not allowed even with consent). Voice Design creates voices from text descriptions. The Commercial License is listed from the Starter plan upward.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Vendor-stated: 'Ultra-low latency (~75ms)' for Flash v2.5; footnote 'Excluding application & network latency' (https://elevenlabs.io/docs/overview/models). Not benchmarked by us.

compatibility.note: Documented endpoint is POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} with an xi-api-key header and an output_format query such as mp3_44100_128; no OpenAI-style /v1/audio/speech mode was found in the pages read. SSML support is partial: break and phoneme tags on v2 models; v3 and v4 do not support break tags.

licensing.commercialUse: Pricing page lists the Commercial License as included from the Starter plan; the Free plan row does not list it.
licensing.attributionOrConditions: Voice cloning is subject to ElevenLabs Terms of Service and Prohibited Use Policy; Professional Voice Clones require a verification process (voice-cloning help page).

compliance.note: Self-attested: docs say ElevenAgents is HIPAA-eligible with BAAs available to eligible customers, and the pricing page lists Scribe v2 Medical as HIPAA-eligible. Whether this extends to the text-to-speech API was not stated on pages read. Zero Retention Mode for API use is described as an Enterprise option. A Trust Center exists (compliance.elevenlabs.io) but its content did not render for us, so SOC 2 and GDPR were not confirmed.

strengths.claim: Expressive model line-up: v4 and v3 support audio tags and multi-speaker dialogue, covering 70+ to 90+ languages.
Large voice catalogue: 3,000+ Voice Library voices plus instant and professional cloning and text-described Voice Design.
WebSocket text-streaming endpoint with word-to-audio alignment for partial text input, plus a vendor-stated ~75ms Flash model for realtime use.
Wide output format choice including mp3, pcm, wav, opus and 8 kHz mu-law and A-law for telephony.
Pay-as-you-go and subscription options with a free plan for evaluation.

limitations.claim: The Free plan does not list a Commercial License; it begins at Starter.
Eleven v4 and v3 do not support SSML break tags; the docs point to other pacing techniques.
The Voice Library is not available via the API to free-tier users.

stepsToMove: Endpoint: ElevenLabs uses POST https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} (and a /stream-input WebSocket); ReadAloud accepts the same route shape on its own host, so for many apps the change is the base URL and key.
Auth: ElevenLabs sends the key in an xi-api-key header; replace with a ReadAloud API key in the same header.
Voice ids: ElevenLabs voice ids (for example JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and library or cloned voices are account-specific and do not carry over; choose a ReadAloud voice id instead.
Output format: output_format query values such as mp3_44100_128 follow the codec_sample_rate_bitrate pattern; check the ReadAloud-supported subset.
Model ids and settings: model_id values (eleven_flash_v2_5, eleven_v3) and voice_settings are ElevenLabs-specific; audio tags and break tags do not translate.

bestFor: Teams that want the most expressive, multi-language, voice-cloning-rich TTS and are comfortable paying premium per-character rates.
